datasets.name: 766f7151
queryLines:
select 
m.MELDUNG_ART as Meldungsart,
m.MELDUNG_NR as MeldungsNr,
m.MELDUNG_TXT as MeldungsText,
i.COST as Kosten,
i.SYS_ID as SYS_ID,
cast(year(i.TIMESTAMP) as string) as Jahr,
lpad(cast(month(i.TIMESTAMP) as string), 2, '0') as Monat,
i.timestamp as Datum
from unternehmen_projekt.bronze.dl_meldungen m
left join unternehmen_projekt.bronze.dl_iot i on m.MELDUNG_NR = i.MESSAGE_NR

datasets.name: 2226a9be
queryLines:
select 
sps.LINIE_NR as Linie,
sps.ANLAGE_NR as Anlage,
sps.SPS_NR as SPS,
iot.TIMESTAMP as Zeitpunkt,
cast(year(iot.TIMESTAMP) as string) as Jahr,
lpad(cast(month(iot.TIMESTAMP) as string), 2, '0') as Monat,iot.COST as Kosten,
iot.PRODUKTNUMMER as Produktnummer,
iot.ZAHLER as Zaehler
from unternehmen_projekt.bronze.dl_sps sps
left join unternehmen_projekt.bronze.dl_iot iot
on iot.SYS_ID = sps.SPS_NR

datasets.name: 1009d554
datasets.displayName: Industrial IoT Data from Bronze Layer
queryLines:
select 
p.MATNR as ProduktNummer,
p.MAKTX as ProduktName,
p.MARKE as Marke,
p.MKST as MKST,
p.BRGEW as BruttoGewicht,
p.HKST as HKST,
i.TIMESTAMP as Zeitpunkt,
i.ZAHLER as Zaehler

from unternehmen_projekt.silver.dwh_produkt_cleaned p 
join unternehmen_projekt.bronze.dl_iot i on p.MATNR = i.PRODUKTNUMMER
